targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.zhezkazgan:crew-/ and (r._field == "value_chamber_properties_value" or r._field == "value_task_properties_value" or r._field == "value_state_properties_value" or r._field == "value_people_properties_value" or r._field == "value_exposure_co_properties_value"))
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["thingId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "parent", "originator", "correlationId", "topic", "host"])

panels.title: Выпуск руды ПДМ за смену, т

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.zhezkazgan:pdm-/ and r._field == "value_tonnes_shift_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: r.thingId}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "default")

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
